scope: Bounded shader texture sampling on physical NPU; no desktop draw or rasterization
addressing: edge-clamped 2D, one mip, decoded float4 texels
compiler_workarounds: Integer index mask retains lossy float/int/float conversion
Separate integer NaN/infinity status avoids miscompiled isfinite selection
Runtime half-texel parameter avoids FP16 constant scale/offset fusion
limitations: No mips, wrap/mirror/border, anisotropy, explicit LOD, gradients or format decoding
Generic Draw and rasterization remain unimplemented
Diagnostic Python probes report pass/fail in JSON; process exit zero alone is not qualification
raw_reproductions: Python source snapshots are stored as .py.txt to preserve the exact diagnostic programs; copy to .py to run with OpenVINO on Delta.
